test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)​​​​​​​
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06181392e9897efb4b81331befbf0235a23822489dcd574e6efffefb8787d3bd.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: MKL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60b94fa466c6a3b5437c302ecbf5031e04e52b23e91c27c090c66c793fc1414a.png] 

Option 2: QOP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df82177cfec77ac325d24c65b6231f342862540418a239158eee4e7a64ada76d.png] 

Option 3: ECD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffd7c6633c3ad924d098da8bb356545eb314ea8ec655c34e7e75ebbc7de79d12.png] 

Option 4: SRR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c46dac1ae183e155a2da18fe19d790751210b52bae7407e60937399d74a449a2.png] 

Thus, SRR does not follow the pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 4.**
